panels.description: Site 6. Tomas stands before Foreman-7 while miners gather behind him; the verified discrepancy glows on the wall. Keep the workers as indistinct silhouettes and leave upper wall space.
Foreman-7's harness displays an active irregularity review as he raises one procedural hand. Leave upper space for his order.
Tomas faces Foreman-7 alone for one beat, square and calm. Leave upper space for his answer.
Workers close ranks around Tomas without individual recognizability. Foreman-7 remains on the opposite side of the frame; leave upper space for Tomas's final line.

items.speaker: TOMAS
items.text: This is just where we stand.
